styles.name: Flat Vector
styles.description: Simple geometric mascot with clean outlines, crisp color areas and minimal shading.

instructions.materials: Use opaque vector-like color fills without simulated paper or material grain.
instructions.forms: Combine clear circles, rounded rectangles and tapered limbs into a compact mascot.
instructions.linework: Draw clean smooth outlines with consistent joins and deliberate simple overlaps.
instructions.shading: Keep shading minimal, limited to a small flat accent where overlap needs clarification.
instructions.palette: Use a stable set of crisp solid colors with obvious foreground-background value separation.
instructions.texture: Leave surfaces smooth and untextured so shape and color do the descriptive work.
instructions.rendering: Rasterize the isolated vector-style construction with controlled edge antialiasing at the target size.

negative_constraints: Avoid glossy gradients, photoreal texture or complex mesh-like shadow fields.
Do not add typography, a badge container or a surrounding illustration scene.
use_cases: Reusable pictograms and simple printed assets
limitations: Very thin outlines can vanish at small sizes; choose visibly robust line weight in the canonical base.

compatibility.scaling: Render with sufficient source detail, then downsample once with the recommended filter into the existing profile cells; inspect the final silhouette at actual size.
notes: This produces raster vector-style artwork through imagegen; it does not promise editable SVG paths.
Keep texture and shading inside the isolated silhouette; preserve the same approved pattern placement across animation states.

negative_constraints: Avoid a detached white border, broad halo or oversized die-cut surround.
